1.1: Lifne edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim asur laset velatet immahen, lehasheilan velishol mehen, lehalevotan velilvot mehen, lefaran velippara mehen. rabbi yehuda omer, nifrain mehen mippene shehu metzer lo. amru lo, af al pi shemmetzer hu achshav, sameach hu leachar zeman:
1.2: Rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha yamim lifnehem ushelosha yamim leacharehem, asur. vachachamim omrim, lifne edehen asur, leachar edehen muttar:
1.3: Veellu edehen shel goyim, kalenda, usetarnura, ukeratesim, veyom genusya shel melachim, veyom halleda, veyom hammita, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol mita sheyyesh bah serefa, yesh bah avoda zara. vesheen bah serefa, en ba avoda zara. yom tiglachat zekano uvelorito, yom sheala vo min hayyam, veyom sheyyatza vo mibbet haasurim, vegoy sheasa mishte livno, eno asur ella oto hayyom veoto haish bilvad:
1.4: Ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara, chutza lah muttar. haya chutza lah avoda zara, tochah muttar. mahu lelech lesham. bizman shehadderech meyuchedet leoto makom, asur. veim haya yachol lehallech bah lemakom acher, muttar. ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara vehayu vah chanuyyot meuttarot vesheenan meuttarot, ze haya maase bevet shean, veamru chachamim, hameuttarot asurot vesheenan meuttarot muttarot:
1.5: Ellu devarim asurim limkor legoyim, itzterobbalin, uvenot shuach ufetotrotehen, ulevona, vetarnegol hallavan. rabbi yehuda omer, muttar limkor lo tarnegol lavan ben hattarnegolin. uvizman shehu vifne atzmo, kotea et etzbao umochro lo, lefi sheen makrivin chaser laavoda zara. ushear kol haddevarim, setaman muttar, uferushan asur. rabbi meir omer, af dekel tav vachatzav veniklivam asur limkor legoyim:
1.6: Mekom shennahagu limkor behema dakka legoyim, mochrin. mekom shennahagu shello limkor, en mochrin. uvechol makom en mochrin lahem behema gassa, agalim useyachim, shelemim ushevurin. rabbi yehuda mattir bishvura. uven betera mattir besus:
1.7: En mochrin lahem dubbin vaarayot vechol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim. en bonin immahem basilki, gardom, veitztadya, uvima. aval bonim immahem bimosyaot uvet merchatzaot. higgiu lakkippa shemmaamidin bah avoda zara, asur livnot:
1.8: Veen osin tachshitin laavoda zara, kutlaot unezamim vetabbaot. rabbi eliezer omer, besachar muttar. en mochrin lahem bimchubbar lakkarka, aval mocher hu mishsheyyikkatzetz. rabbi yehuda omer, mocher hu lo al menat lakotz. en maskirin lahem battim beeretz yisrael, veen tzarich lomar sadot. uvesureya maskirin lahem battim, aval lo sadot. uvechutz laaretz mochrin lahem battim umaskirin sadot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, beeretz yisrael maskirin lahem battim, aval lo sadot. uvesureya mochrin battim umaskirin sadot. uvechutza laaretz mochrin ellu vaellu:
1.9: Af bimkom sheamru lehasekir, lo levet dira amru, mippene shehu machnis letocho avoda zara, shenneemar (Devarim 7) velo tavi toeva el betecha. uvechol makom lo yaskir lo et hammerchatz, mippene shehu nikra al shemo:

2.1: En maamidin behema befundekaot shel goyim, mippene shechashudin al harvia. velo tityached ishsha immahen, mippene shechashudin al haarayot. velo yityached adam immahen, mippene shechashudin al shefichat damim. bat yisrael lo teyalled et hannachrit, mippene shemmeyalledet ben laavoda zara. aval nachrit meyalledet bat yisrael. bat yisrael lo tanik benah shel nachrit, aval nachrit menika venah shel yisreelit birshutah:
2.2: Mitrappein mehen rippuy mamon, aval lo rippuy nefashot. veen mistapperin mehen bechol makom, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, birshut harabbim muttar, aval lo veno leveno:
2.3: Ellu devarim shel goyim asurin veissuran issur hanaa. hayyayin, vehachometz shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin, vecheres haderiyyani, veorot levuvin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bizman shehakkera shello agol, asur. mashuch, muttar. basar hannichnas laavoda zara, muttar. vehayyotze, asur, mippene shehu chezivche metim, divre rabbi akiva. haholchin lattarput, asur laset velatet immahem. vehabbain, muttarin:
2.4: Nodot haggoyim vekankannehen veyayin shel yisrael kanus bahen, asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en issuran issur hanaa. hachartzannim vehazzaggin shel goyim asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, lachin, asurin, yeveshin, muttarin. hammuryas ugevinot bet unyaki shel goyim asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en issuran issur hanaa:
2.5: Amar rabbi yehuda, shaal rabbi yishmael et rabbi yehoshua, keshehayu mehallechin badderech. amar lo, mippene ma asru gevinot haggoyim. amar lo, mippene shemmaamidin otah bekeva shel nevela. amar lo, vahalo kevat ola chamura mikkevat nevela, veamru, kohen sheddato yafa, sorfah chayya. velo hodu lo, aval amru, en nehenin velo moalin. chazar, amar lo, mippene shemmaamidin otah bekevat egle avoda zara. amar lo, im ken, lamma lo asaruha vahanaa. hissio ledavar acher, amar lo, yishmael achi, heach atta kore (Shir hashshirim 1), ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, o ki tovim dodayich. amar lo, ki tovim dodayich. amar lo, en haddavar ken, shehare chavero melammed alav, lereach shemanecha tovim:
2.6: Ellu devarim shel goyim asurin veen issuran issur hanaa. chalav shechalavo goy veen yisrael roehu, vehappat, vehashshemen shellahen. rabbi uvet dino hittiru vashshemen. ushelakot, uchevashin sheddarkan latet letochan yayin vachometz, vetarit terufa, vetzir sheen bah daga chilbit shotetet bo, vehachillak, vekoret shel chiltit, umelach salkontit, hare ellu asurin veen issuran issur hanaa:
2.7: Ellu muttarin baachila. chalav shechalavo goy veyisrael roehu. vehaddevash. vehaddavdaniyyot af al pi shemmenattefin, en bahem mishshum hechsher mashke. uchevashin sheen darkan latet letochan yayin vachometz. vetarit sheenah terufa. vetzir sheyyesh bah daga. veale shel chiltit. vezetim geluskaot hamegulgalin. rabbi yose omer, hashsheluchin, asurin. hachagavim habbaim min hasselula, asurin. min hahaftek, muttarin. vechen litruma:

3.1: Kol hatztzelamim asurim, mippene shehen neevadin paam achat bashshana, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno asur ella chol sheyyesh beyado makkel o tzippor o chaddur. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol sheyyesh beyado chol davar:
3.2: Hammotze shivre tzelamim, hare ellu muttarim. matza tavnit yad o tavnit regel, hare ellu asurim, mippene shekkayyotze vahen neevad:
3.3: Hammotze chelim vaalehem tzurat chamma, tzurat levana, tzurat derakon, yolichem leyam hammelach. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, sheal hamechubbadin, asurim. sheal hamevuzzin, muttarin. rabbi yose omer, shochek vezore laruach o mattil layyam. amru lo, af hu naase zevel, shenneemar (Devarim 13) velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem:
3.4: Shaal peroklos ben filosfos et rabban gamliel beakko, shehaya rochetz bammerchatz shel afroditi, amar lo, katuv betoratchem, velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem. mippene ma atta rochetz bammerchatz shel afroditi. amar lo, en meshivin bammerchatz. uchesheyyatza amar lo, ani lo vati vigvulah, hi vata vigvuli, en omrim, naase merchatz leafroditi noy, ella omrim, naase afroditi noy lammerchatz. davar acher, im notnin lecha mamon harebe, i atta nichnas laavoda zara shellecha arom uvaal keri umashtin befaneha, vezo omedet al pi habbiv vechol haam mashtinin lefaneha. lo neemar ella elohehem. et shennoheg bo mishshum eloah, asur. veet sheeno noheg bo mishshum eloah, muttar:
3.5: Haggoyim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot, hen muttarin uma shealehem asurim, shenneemar (Devarim 7) lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem velakachta. rabbi yose haggelili omer, (sham 12) elohehem al heharim, velo heharim elohehem. elohehem al haggevaot, velo haggevaot elohehem. umippene ma ashera asura, mippene sheyyesh bah tefisat yad adam, vechol sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam asur. amar rabbi akiva, ani ovin veadun lefanecha. kol makom sheatta motze har gavoah vegiva nissaa veetz raanan, da sheyyesh sham avoda zara:
3.6: Mi shehaya veto samuch laavoda zara venafal, asur livnoto. ketzad yaase, kones betoch shello arba ammot uvone. haya shello veshel avoda zara, niddon mechetza al mechetza. avanav etzav vaafaro, metammein kashsheretz, shenneemar (Devarim 7) shakketz teshakketzennu. rabbi akiva omer, kannidda, shenneemar (yeshaya 30) tizrem kemo dava, tze tomar lo, ma nidda metammea vemassa, af avoda zara metammea vemassa:
3.7: Shelosha vattim hen. bayit shebbanuy mittechilla laavoda zara, hare ze asur. siyyedo vechiyyero laavoda zara vechiddesh, notel ma shechiddesh. hichnis letocha avoda zara vehotziah, hare ze muttar. shalosh avanim hen. even shechatzavah mittechilla levimos, hare zo asura. siyyedah vechiyyerah leshem avoda zara vechiddesh, notel ma shechiddesh. heemid aleha avoda zara vesillekah, hare zo mutteret. shalosh asherot hen. ilan shennetao mittechilla leshem avoda zara, hare ze asur. giddeo ufisselo leshem avoda zara vehechelif, notel ma shehechelif. heemid tachteha avoda zara uvittelah, hare ze muttar. ezo hi ashera, kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheovdin otah. umaase vetzaydan beilan shehayu ovdin oto, umatzu tachtav gal. amar lahen rabbi shimon, bidku et haggal hazze, uvedakuhu umatzu vo tzura. amar lahen, hoil velatztzura hen ovdin, nattir lahen et hailan:
3.8: Lo yeshev betzillah. veim yashav, tahor. velo yaavor tachteha. veim avar, tame. hayta gozelet et harabbim, veavar tachteha, tahor. vezorin tachteha yerakot bimot haggeshamim aval lo vimot hachamma. vehachazarin, lo vimot hachamma velo vimot haggeshamim. rabbi yose omer, af lo yerakot bimot haggeshamim, mippene shehannemiyya nosheret alehen vehova lahen lezavel:
3.9: Natal mimmenna etzim, asurim bahanaa. hissik bahen et hattannur, im chadash, yuttatz. veim yashan, yutztzan. afa vo et happat, asura vahanaa. nitarva vaacherot, kullan asurot bahanaa. rabbi eliezer omer, yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. amru lo, en pidyon laavoda zara. natal hemenna charkor, asur bahanaa. arag bo et habbeged, habbeged asur bahanaa. nitarev baacherim vaacherim baacherim, kullan asurin bahanaa. rabbi eliezer omer, yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. amru lo, en pidyon laavoda zara:
3.10: Ketzad mevattelah. kirsem, vezerad, natal mimmenna makkel o sharvit, afillu ale, hare zo vetela. shefayah letzarkah, asura. shello letzarkah, mutteret:

4.1: Rabbi yishmael omer, shalosh avanim zo vetzad zo betzad markulis, asurot. ushetayim, muttarot. vachachamim omrim, shennirot immo, asurot. vesheen nirot immo, muttarot:
4.2: Matza verosho maot, kesut o chelim, hare ellu muttarin. parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim veyenot ushemanim uselatot vechol davar shekkayyotze vo karev al gabbe hammizbeach, asur:
4.3: Avoda zara shehaya lah ginna o merchatz, nehenin mehen shello vetova veen nehenin mehen betova. haya shellah veshel acherim, nehenin mehen ben betova uven shello vetova:
4.4: Avoda zara shel nachri, asura miyyad. veshel yisrael, en asura ad shetteaved. nachri mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero, veyisrael eno mevattel avoda zara shel nachri. hamevattel avoda zara, bittel meshammesheha. bittel meshammesheha, meshammesheha muttarin vehi asura:
4.5: Ketzad mevattelah, kata rosh aznah, rosh chatmah, rosh etzbaah, pechasah af al pi shello chisserah, bittelah. rakak befaneha, hishtin befaneha, gerarah, vezarak bah et hatztzoa, hare zo enah betela. mecharah o mishkenah, rabbi omer, bittel. vachachamim omrim, lo vittel:
4.6: Avoda zara shehinnichuha ovdeha bishat shalom, mutteret. bishat milchama, asura. bimosyaot shel melachim, hare ellu muttarot, mippene shemmaamidin otam beshaa shehammelachim ovrim:
4.7: Shaalu et hazzekenim beromi, im en retzono baavoda zara, lama eno mevattelah. amru lahen, illu ledavar sheen tzorech laolam bo hayu ovdin, haya mevattelo. hare hen ovdin lachamma velallevana velakkochavim velammazzalot. yeabbed olamo mippene hashshotim. amru lahen, im ken, yeabbed davar sheen tzorech laolam bo veyanniach davar shetztzorech haolam bo. amru lahen, af anu machazikin yede ovdehem shel ellu, sheomrim, tedu shehen elohot, shehare hen lo vatalu:
4.8: Lokchin gat beuta min haggoy af al pi shehu notel beyado venoten lattappuach. veeno naase yen nesech, ad sheyyered labbor. yarad labbor, ma shebbabbor asur, vehashshear muttar:
4.9: Dorchin im haggoy baggat, aval lo votzrin immo. yisrael shehu ose vetuma, lo dorchin velo votzrin immo, aval molichin immo chaviyyot laggat, umeviin immo min haggat. nachtom shehu ose vetuma, lo lashin velo orchin immo, aval molichin immo fat lappalter:
4.10: Goy shennimtza omed betzad habbor shel yayin, im yesh lo alav milva, asur. en lo alav milva, muttar. nafal labbor veala, umedado vakkane, hittiz et hatztzira vakkane o shehaya metappeach al pi chavit meruttachat, bechol ellu haya maase, veamru yimmacher. verabbi shimon mattir. natal et hechavit uzerakah bachamato labbor, ze haya maase vehichshiru:
4.11: Hametaher yeno shel nachri venotno virshuto bevayit happatuach lirshut harabbim, beir sheyyesh bah goyim veyisreelim, muttar. beir shekkullah goyim, asur, ad sheyyoshiv shomer. veen hashshomer tzarich lihyot yoshev umeshammer. af al pi shehu yotze venichnas, muttar. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, kol reshut goyim achat hi:
4.12: Hammetaher yeno shel nachri venotno virshuto, vehalla chotev lo, hitkabbalti mimmecha maot, muttar. aval im yirtze yisrael lehotzio veeno mannicho ad sheyyitten lo et meotav, ze haya maase vevet shean, veasru chachamim:

5.1: Hassocher et happoel laasot immo veyen nesech, secharo asur. secharo laasot immo melacha acheret, af al pi sheamar lo haaver li chavit shel yen nesech mimmakom lemakom, secharo muttar. hasocher et hachamor lehavi aleha yen nesech, secharah asur. secharah leshev aleha, af al pi shehinniach haggoy legino aleha, secharah muttar:
5.2: Yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim, yedichen vehen muttarot. veim hayu mevukkaot, asurot. nafal al gabbe teenim o al gabbe temarim, im yesh bahen benoten taam, asur. maase bevaytos ben zonan shehevi gerogarot bisfina, venishtabbera chavit shel yen nesech venafal al gabbehen, veshaal lachachamim vehittirum. ze hakkelal, kol shebbahanaato benoten taam, asur. kol sheen bahanaato benoten taam, muttar, kegon chometz shennafal al gabbe gerisin:
5.3: Nachri shehaya maavir im yisrael kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom, im haya vechezkat hammishtammer, muttar. im hodio shehu maflig, kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov:
5.4: Hammanniach yeno vekaron o visfina vehalach lo vekappandarya, nichnas lammedina verachatz, muttar. im hodio shehu maflig, kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov. hammanniach nachri vachanut, af al pi shehu yotze venichnas, muttar. veim hodio shehu maflig, kede sheyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov:
5.5: Haya ochel immo al hashshulchan vehinniach legina al hashshulchan, ulegina al haddulbeki, vehinnicho veyatza, ma sheal hashshulchan, asur. uma sheal haddulbeki, muttar. veim amar lo heve mozeg veshote, af sheal haddulbeki asur. chaviyyot petuchot, asurot. setumot, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov:
5.6: Balleshet goyim shennichnesa lair bishat shalom, chaviyyot petuchot, asurot. setumot, muttarot. bishat milchama, ellu vaellu muttarot, lefi sheen penay lenassech:
5.7: Ummanin shel yisrael sheshshalach lahem nachri chavit shel yen nesech bischaran, muttarim lomar lo ten lanu et dameha. veim mishshennichnesa lirshutan, asur. hammocher yeno lannachri, pasak ad shello madad, damav muttarin. madad ad shello fasak, damav asurin. natal et hammashpech umadad letoch tzelochito shel nachri, vechazar umadad letoch tzelochito shel yisrael, im yesh bo akkevet yayin, asur. hameare mikkeli el keli, et sheera mimmennu, muttar. veet sheera letocho, asur:
5.8: Yen nesech asur, veoser bechol shehu. yayin beyayin umayim bemayim, bechol shehu. yayin bemayim umayim beyayin, benoten taam. ze hakkelal, min bemino, bemashshehu. veshello vemino, benoten taam:
5.9: Ellu asurin, veosrin bechol shehen. yen nesech, vaavoda zara, veorot levuvin, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa, vetzippore metzora, usear nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vesair hammishtalleach, vechullin shennishchatu vaazara, hare ellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen:
5.10: Yen nesech shennafal levor, kullo asur bahanaa. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, yimmacher kullo lenachri, chutz middeme yen nesech shebbo:
5.11: Gat shel even shezzippetah goy, menaggevah vehi tehora. veshel etz, rabbi omer, yenaggev. vachachamim omrim, yiklof et hazzefet. veshel cheres, af al pi shekkalaf et hazzefet, hare zo asura:
5.12: Hallokeach kele tashmish min haggoy, et sheddarko lehatebil, yatbil. lehageil, yagil. lelabben baur, yelabben baur. hashshappud vehaaskela, melabbenan baur. hassakkin, shafah vehi tehora:
